meta.unit: USD, cumulative daily net after costs
meta.resolution: daily, every calendar day, no downsampling
meta.bankroll: 500,000 USD start; each row's daily net times its sizing-view scale (MW per position at which the build-year worst drawdown is 100,000 USD, capped at 5); costs scale linearly with size
meta.flags: candidate_by_rule = passes the bar at the sizing view and is not fragile (lab flag or audit flag), computed here from the results file; comparison = every other row (OBJECTIVES.md, 7 Oct selection rule) or a registered comparison row; reference = always supply and the baseline; the official approved list is published separately
meta.holdout: build years only: every daily table filtered at read to dates before 2024-01-01, asserted; nothing on or after 2024-01-01 was read

rows.name: always_supply
rows.line: Virtual supply in every zone-hour, every day.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: baseline_usual_side
rows.line: Each zone-hour takes the side of its average gap over the trailing 365 days (supply if real time usually settles below day ahead, load if above).
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: A_hourly_mean
rows.line: Supply only in the zone-hours whose trailing 365-day average gap is at or below minus the supply cost; no model.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: idea1_storm_filter
rows.line: Sit out the whole day when the hand-made storm score (highest of four trailing-year percentile ranks: peak load forecast, coldest and hottest forecast temperature, the gap already published for D) is above a cut; otherwise supply everywhere.
fragile_reasons: three-year total changes sign at a neighbouring setting

rows.name: idea2_storm_flip
rows.line: Same storm score; virtual load in every zone-hour on flagged days, supply on the others.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
fragile per storm audit (side/storm_audit.md)

rows.name: idea8_storm_zone_pairs
rows.line: On flagged storm days, load in N.Y.C. and LONGIL against supply in two upstate zones (cut and the two zones chosen on the year before); supply everywhere on the other days.
fragile_reasons: three-year total changes sign at a neighbouring setting
three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: idea10_weather_surprise
rows.line: Virtual load all day when the latest GFS run, against the run before it, moves D+1's temperatures further from 18.3 C than on most days of the trailing year (rank above a cut); otherwise supply.
fragile_reasons: fragile per idea 10 audit (side/idea10_audit.md)

rows.name: idea9_tail_spike_S100
rows.line: Idea A with spikes defined as real time at least 100 USD above day ahead: supply in every zone-hour except where the gradient-boosting probability of such a spike exceeds p* (0.02 or 0.05, chosen on the year before).
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: idea7_gbm_storm_filter
rows.line: LightGBM reads the deep model's day features and gives the probability that the next day's always-supply book loses more than the worst-tenth day of its training window; sit out the whole day when it is above a cut chosen on the year before, otherwise supply.

rows.name: idea3_deep_storm_filter
rows.line: The deep day model's probability that the next day's always-supply book has a worst-tenth loss; sit out the whole day when it is above a cut, otherwise supply.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: idea4_deep_storm_three_way
rows.line: Same deep probability with two cuts: supply below the first, sit out between, virtual load in every zone-hour at or above the second.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: idea5_deep_zone_day
rows.line: The deep model predicts each zone's next-day supply profit after cost; supply that zone all day when the prediction is above zero, virtual load when it is below minus (the load break-even plus a margin chosen on the year before), otherwise nothing.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: idea6_deep_two_gates
rows.line: Idea 3's day gate (sit out days the deep day model flags), then inside the days that pass, the deep hourly spike model: supply every zone-hour except where its spike probability is above p*.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: idea11_learned_allocator
rows.line: A deep gate network weights four simple experts per zone and day (always supply, sit out, virtual load, the storm-day zone pair), trained on their realised profit in earlier days; the position is the weighted mix, held all day.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: idea12_policy_network
rows.line: A deep network outputs each zone's position for the next day directly, from minus 1 (supply) to plus 1 (load), trained on next-day profit after costs minus a penalty on losses; held all day.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: idea14_learned_allocator_candidates
rows.line: A deep gate splits one unit of risk per day between C deep, B gbm, C gbm and B deep, each pre-scaled to a 100,000 USD drawdown with scales from data before each refit; trained on earlier days' realised profits, pulled toward equal weights (registered after the table was seen).

rows.name: side_past_spike_rate_filter
rows.line: Supply everywhere except zone-hours whose spike frequency (real time 25 USD or more above day ahead) in all earlier years is in the top k of the previous 30 days' scores; k chosen on the year before.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: A_regression_v1
rows.line: Sell supply where a gradient-boosting forecast of the gap is below minus the cost (A as first registered).

rows.name: A_regression_v1_deep
rows.line: As A regression, with the deep model's forecast.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: A_spike_deep
rows.line: As A spike flag, with the deep model's spike probability.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: A_spike_deep_rolling_cut
rows.line: Sell supply everywhere except hours whose deep spike score is in the top k of the last 30 days (a side-check rule).
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: A_spike_gbm
rows.line: Sell supply everywhere except hours a gradient-boosting model flags as likely real-time spikes.

rows.name: A_spike_tail_S100_gbm [second build]
rows.line: As A spike flag, but the model looks only for extreme spikes (real time 100 USD/MWh or more above day ahead).
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: B_deep
rows.line: As B, with the deep model.

rows.name: B_gbm
rows.line: Trade either side where a forecast using weather forecasts expects the gap to beat the cost.

rows.name: C_deep
rows.line: As C (same pairs), with the deep model's forecasts.

rows.name: C_gbm
rows.line: Buy one zone and sell another in five fixed zone pairs when the forecast spread beats both legs' costs.

rows.name: D_deep
rows.line: As D, with the deep model.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time

rows.name: D_gbm
rows.line: Trade either side where a forecast using scheduled transmission outages expects the gap to beat the cost.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days

rows.name: risk_sized_supply_gbm
rows.line: Sell supply everywhere, sized down from 1 MW in proportion to how high the hour's spike score ranks in the last 30 days.

rows.name: storm_day_filter [second build]
rows.line: Sell supply everywhere, but skip whole days whose forecast load, forecast cold or heat, or this morning's real-time gap is extreme for the past year.
fragile_reasons: three-year total changes sign at a neighbouring setting

rows.name: storm_day_flip [second build]
rows.line: As the storm-day filter, but on storm days buy virtual load everywhere instead of sitting out.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
fragile per storm audit (side/storm_audit.md)

rows.name: zone_subset_supply
rows.line: Sell supply every hour, but only in up to six zones that earned without their worst hours and had the mildest worst day in earlier years.
fragile_reasons: three-year total turns negative without one year's best 10 days
random days in the same months beat the rule more than 20 percent of the time
